project.title: Demo: tuning a 145.5 MHz dipole
project.note: Simulated measurements for demonstration. The recorded length is the combined length of both arms, excluding the feed gap. Resonance was identified at the reactance zero crossing. SWR and R+jX are recorded at 145.5 MHz with a 50-ohm reference impedance.
project.installation: Horizontal dipole made from two 6 mm diameter copper tubes. The center is 3 m above ground on a fiberglass mast, with a 12 mm feed gap.
project.feedline: 5 m of 50-ohm RG-58 coax. A 1:1 current choke is fitted at the feed point. The VNA was calibrated at the end of the test cable, at the feed point.

records.title: 01. Initial measurement
records.note: Both arms are 505 mm long. An initial VNA sweep shows the reactance crossing zero below the target frequency.
records.installation: Horizontal dipole made from two 6 mm diameter copper tubes. The center is 3 m above ground on a fiberglass mast, with a 12 mm feed gap.
records.feedline: 5 m of 50-ohm RG-58 coax. A 1:1 current choke is fitted at the feed point. The VNA was calibrated at the end of the test cable, at the feed point.

records.title: 02. Trimmed 6 mm per arm
records.note: Removed 6 mm from the outer end of each arm, leaving each arm 499 mm long. The mounting height and feedline routing stayed the same.
records.installation: Horizontal dipole made from two 6 mm diameter copper tubes. The center is 3 m above ground on a fiberglass mast, with a 12 mm feed gap.
records.feedline: 5 m of 50-ohm RG-58 coax. A 1:1 current choke is fitted at the feed point. The VNA was calibrated at the end of the test cable, at the feed point.

records.title: 03. Trimmed another 4.5 mm per arm
records.note: Removed another 4.5 mm from each arm. Resonance is still about 0.9 MHz below the target.
records.installation: Horizontal dipole made from two 6 mm diameter copper tubes. The center is 3 m above ground on a fiberglass mast, with a 12 mm feed gap.
records.feedline: 5 m of 50-ohm RG-58 coax. A 1:1 current choke is fitted at the feed point. The VNA was calibrated at the end of the test cable, at the feed point.

records.title: 04. Final check
records.note: Removed another 3 mm from each arm, leaving each arm 491.5 mm long. After tightening the mounts, repeated the VNA sweep with the same setup.
records.installation: Horizontal dipole made from two 6 mm diameter copper tubes. The center is 3 m above ground on a fiberglass mast, with a 12 mm feed gap.
records.feedline: 5 m of 50-ohm RG-58 coax. A 1:1 current choke is fitted at the feed point. The VNA was calibrated at the end of the test cable, at the feed point.
